mentions.name: Today I Will Destroy You
mentions.description: This is a sword combat action game about a girl who goes looking for her sister, with combat inspired by Sekiro. It is currently in playtesting on PC, and the training and difficulty curve are being adjusted so it doesn't get too hard too soon and frustrate new players.
mentions.problem: The game gets way too hard too soon, frustrating new players, so the training and difficulty curve are being rebalanced.
mentions.audience: PC players who enjoyed Sekiro, sought as playtesters
mentions.source_excerpt: I just started running sword combat playtests this weekend for my next game, Today I Will Destroy You, which is about a girl who goes looking for her sister.
